items.summary: Design recommendation: preserve containment-only execution while delivery remains saturated at 10/10 slots. The highest-value reversible candidate is the existing allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA refinement; do not create duplicate work. After one slot clears, implement only on the existing merchandising entry surface: clarify the primary product CTA, keep the affiliate disclosure adjacent and visible, preserve destinations, and improve keyboard focus, target size, contrast, and mobile spacing. Baseline evidence: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for the available 2026-09-21 window; no conversion lift is claimed. Measure CTA click-through and downstream attributable outcomes when available. Roll back the single diff if link, accessibility, disclosure, build, or measurement checks fail.
